decisions.decision: Use source-supported negation motivation and survey procedure/artifact; no inventory of background computational approaches is promoted to method.

Retain overview/evaluation/taxonomy procedures and all three qualified comparative findings; no unnamed question list is invented as a named dataset. Restored database-NLI scope in all three performance findings per independent B correction.
Keep both algorithms actually studied, introduced cost-sensitive measures and the complete paired spam-filtering comparison; unnamed corpus stays no named dataset.

Use A task setting (Settlers of Catan) and B operational method components/workflow. Restore both model definition and Catan setting in preliminary-potential finding; A1 hypothesis is not a finding. Do not add redundant generic hybrid-parent method.

Restore formal-property research objectives from A3/A5 and practical axiomatization objective. Keep contextual/HiLog methods and scoped decidability/undecidability/capability claims; OWL languages/logics are not invented dataset resources.

Proposed A5 similarity functions are methods; exact-GO/gene-overlap are validation baselines, retained in full comparison finding rather than methods. Disease-similarity task is sufficient; term/entity functionality is retained in methods/artifacts. Keep all quantitative tradeoffs, external-set correlation and expression finding. Gene Ontology is the structured resource; unnamed manually curated dataset stays unnamed. A6 generic statement not added as a broader unsupported separate outcome.

Retain survey procedure and no unnamed typological database resource. Add explicit typological-information/system-performance antecedent to causal finding, retaining to-date/modest/coverage/granularity/under-utilization qualifications.

Both model families are methods because empirical comparison is the explicit objective. Restore word-order scope to A2/A3/A4 and combined-model benchmark finding; keep can/relatively-small/training-time caveats and separate error-distribution finding.
Join quality gain with its bias caveat rather than leaving an unqualified positive item; retain POS/Penn-Treebank/setup context and separate weak-tagger speed finding.

Keep actual arc contractions, weighted FST and parsing algorithm as methods; retain scoped projective complexity and modal customization/extension capability without claiming new measured high recall from prior results.

Keep actual question-to-triples-to-RDF procedure, linguistic/semantic features and defined grammar rules. Adopt A coverage of explicitly proposed procedure/rule artifacts as distinguishable authored operational contributions, not an automatic parent/component union. A treats fewer contribution items as materially acceptable; B accepts A coverage. This granularity ruling does not change policy.

Keep temporal-context workflow linked to actual content/user/propagation feature antecedents; use A early-detection finding with two-microblog-dataset experimental setting and early-broadcast condition.
